name: Dick Erixon - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the control of the financial activities of the European Investment Bank Group – annual report 2024
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on how the European Investment Bank, the EU's public lending bank, should be watched over and what it should fund. It asks for stronger outside audits, better protection against conflicts of interest, and clearer reporting on results rather than just how much money was lent. It also calls for safeguards on lending outside the EU, lessons to be learned from the Northvolt bankruptcy, and more support for defence and security projects. These are recommendations, not new laws.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the bank to reform audits, ethics rules and reporting.
- **Who it affects:** The European Investment Bank, its borrowers, and EU taxpayers backing its loans.
- **What happens next:** Parliament sends its demands to the Council and the bank, which is asked to debate them.
